headline: OpenAI reports Third Moment Research runs 10,000 agents in 36–48-hour investigations
summary: An Oct 14 OpenAI customer case study reports that Third Moment Research runs 10,000 concurrent agents on 36–48-hour computational investigations. It describes a quantitative-finance workflow using Codex to diagnose a backtest bottleneck and reduce one year of order-level US-equity backtesting from roughly 3 hours to roughly 3–5 minutes through caching and memory packing. The account also describes a Dockerized environment and an outer harness that can retry, terminate or escalate unfinished tasks to human review. These are claims published by the model provider and attributed to its customer; no independent run logs or audit are included. The story does not establish trading performance, general autonomous research quality or the provider page’s future scale-up roadmap.
